models.permitted_use: Theoretical/educational computation of present values for level end-of-period (ordinary-annuity/annuity-immediate) retirement withdrawal streams at a fixed positive per-period rate with matched price basis; guards A>=0, i>0, n>=1 must hold. Not permitted for beginning-of-period (annuity-due), growing, variable, life-contingent, or indexed streams, for mortality/longevity inference, or for the i=0 case (separate P=A*n branch).
